text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps the essay centered on defending that claim."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with reasons and rebuttal","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in a more structured way with a clear introduction, body, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"specific article-based support","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It cites several concrete details from the source article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"explains how technology could solve drawbacks","quality":"reasoning","description":"It does more to connect evidence to conclusions by explaining why the problems are manageable over time."},{"evidence":"addresses liability and regulations","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges opposing concerns and tries to respond to them rather than only restating support."},{"evidence":"fewer distracting errors and clearer sentence flow","quality":"control of expression","description":"Its writing is generally clearer and easier to follow despite some mistakes."}]}
